# Project Tasks

Manage tasks in Teamleader Focus projects.

Tasks in the current ("nextgen") project system — `projects-v2/tasks.*`.

For the older task system, see `Tasks`.

```php
Teamleader::projectTasks()
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Class | `McoreServices\TeamleaderSDK\Resources\Projects\ProjectTasks` |
| Create / update / delete | ✓ / ✓ / ✓ |
| Pagination | `page_size` / `page_number`; no totals — a short page is the last one |

## Endpoints

- `projects-v2/tasks.assign`
- `projects-v2/tasks.create`
- `projects-v2/tasks.delete`
- `projects-v2/tasks.duplicate`
- `projects-v2/tasks.info`
- `projects-v2/tasks.list`
- `projects-v2/tasks.unassign`
- `projects-v2/tasks.update`

## Filters

Passed as the first argument to `list()`. Any other key throws.

| Filter | Description |
|---|---|
| `ids` | Array of task UUIDs |

## Accepted values

Public constants on the class. Body fields and enum values outside these lists
throw before the request is sent.

| Constant | Values |
|---|---|
| `ASSIGNEE_TYPES` | `team`, `user` |
| `BILLING_METHODS` | `user_rate`, `work_type_rate`, `custom_rate`, `fixed_price`, `parent_fixed_price`, `non_billable` |
| `COLORS` | `#00B2B2`, `#008A8C`, `#992600`, `#ED9E00`, `#D157D3`, `#A400B2`, `#0071F2`, `#004DA6`, `#64788F`, `#C0C0C4`, `#82828C`, `#1A1C20` |
| `CREATE_FIELDS` | `project_id`, `title`, `group_id`, `work_type_id`, `task_type_id`, `description`, `billing_method`, `fixed_price`, `external_budget`, `internal_budget`, `custom_rate`, `start_date`, `end_date`, `time_estimated`, `assignees` |
| `CURRENCIES` | `BAM`, `CAD`, `CHF`, `CLP`, `CNY`, `COP`, `CZK`, `DKK`, `EUR`, `GBP`, `INR`, `ISK`, `JPY`, `MAD`, `MXN`, `NOK`, `PEN`, `PLN`, `RON`, `SEK`, `TRY`, `USD`, `ZAR` |
| `DELETE_STRATEGIES` | `unlink_time_tracking`, `delete_time_tracking` |
| `STATUSES` | `to_do`, `in_progress`, `on_hold`, `done` |
| `TIME_UNITS` | `hours`, `minutes`, `seconds` |
| `UPDATE_FIELDS` | `work_type_id`, `task_type_id`, `status`, `title`, `description`, `billing_method`, `fixed_price`, `external_budget`, `internal_budget`, `custom_rate`, `start_date`, `end_date`, `time_estimated` |
| `UPDATE_STRATEGIES` | `none`, `cascade` |

## Methods

### `list()`

```php
list(array $filters = [], array $options = []): array
```

List tasks

Before v2.2.9 any filter was a fatal error: list() called a
buildFilters() method the class did not define.

- `$filters` — ids (a UUID or a list of UUIDs)
- `$options` — page_size, page_number

**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException` On an unknown filter key or option

### `info()`

```php
info($id, $includes = null): array
```

Get one task

- `$id` — Task UUID
- `$includes` — tasks.info takes no includes; passing any throws

### `create()`

```php
create(array $data): array
```

Create a task

Requires project_id and title. With billing_method `work_type_rate`, a
work_type_id is required as well.

**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException` When a required field is missing, or a field or value is not accepted

### `update()`

```php
update($id, array $data): array
```

Update a task

Every field is optional; null clears a nullable field.

- `$id` — Task UUID

**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException` When a field or value is not accepted

### `delete()`

```php
delete($id, ...$additionalParams): array
```

Delete a task

- `$id` — Task UUID
- `$additionalParams` — Delete strategy: unlink_time_tracking (default) or delete_time_tracking

**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`

### `duplicate()`

```php
duplicate(string $originId): array
```

Duplicate a task (without its time trackings)

- `$originId` — UUID of the task to duplicate

### `byIds()`

```php
byIds(array $ids): array
```

Get tasks by ID

- `$ids` — Task UUIDs

### `updateStatus()`

```php
updateStatus(string $taskId, string $status): array
```

Update a task's status

- `$status` — to_do, in_progress, on_hold or done

### `getResponseStructure()`

```php
getResponseStructure(): array
```

Get response structure documentation

## Examples

Get all tasks:

```php
$tasks = Teamleader::projectTasks()->list();
```

Create a new task:

```php
$task = Teamleader::projectTasks()->create([
    'project_id' => 'uuid',
    'title' => 'Write API documentation',
    'billing_method' => 'user_rate'
]);
```

Update task status:

```php
$task = Teamleader::projectTasks()->update('task-uuid', [
    'status' => 'in_progress'
]);
```

Assign a user to a task:

```php
Teamleader::projectTasks()->assign('task-uuid', 'user', 'user-uuid');
```

Delete a task and unlink time tracking:

```php
Teamleader::projectTasks()->delete('task-uuid', 'unlink_time_tracking');
```
